'''Sig Coven''' was a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who would introduce himself as an "independent fortune seeker and scout". He was skilled at melee combat, [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]], and computer programming, and was known to carry a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], a [[Glowrod/Legends|glowrod]], [[thincord]], and a [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]].

At some point, he happened upon ''[[Kragg's Fury]]''. Not able to identify the ship, he teamed up with [[Jonas Durns]], Durns' family, and a group of other spacers for an expedition to explore and identify the ship.<ref name="Silent Fury">{{JournalCite|7|Silent Fury}}</ref>
